features.label: Features
features.title: Built to protect your capital
features.subtitle: Real-time behavioral intervention powered by AI, designed specifically for retail traders who struggle with discipline.

features.title: Set unbreakable trading rules
features.description: Define your own trading rules, setup your risk settings and stick to them: daily loss limits, max trades, time windows, blocked tickers. Enable Strict Mode to enforce the rules you set, even when emotions take over.

features.title: Stop emotional trades in real time
features.description: Chrome extension monitors your trading activity in real time. Get instant alerts before you place a revenge trade or break your plan. Act before it's too late.

features.title: Identify where you lose control
features.description: AI detects overtrading patterns, revenge sequences, and repeated rule violations. Identify your triggers early—before they compound losses and spiral out of control.

features.title: Track discipline, not just P&L
features.description: Analytics dashboard that tracks rule adherence, discipline score, and behavioral patterns. Focus on what truly matters: your process, not just profits.

features.title: Start each session with clarity
features.description: Daily pre-market analysis powered by Claude AI. Review yesterday's performance, set today's risk limits, and commit to your plan before the bell rings. Consistency beats conviction.

roi.title: Discipline over performance
roi.intro: TradeSafe's discipline layer is not designed to increase win rates or predict profitable trades.
roi.subtitle: Its value lies in reducing costly behavioral mistakes:
points: Better adherence to pre-defined risk rules
roi.impact: For many retail traders, a 10-15% reduction in avoidable losses has a larger long-term impact than chasing higher returns through new strategies.
roi.conclusion: TradeSafe aims to improve consistency by helping you protect yourself from your own worst decisions.

steps.title: Set your risk rules
steps.description: Configure your daily loss limits, max trades per day, time restrictions, and blocked tickers. Enable Strict Mode for unbreakable enforcement.

steps.title: Trade with protection
steps.description: Our Chrome extension monitors your trading in real-time. Get instant alerts when you approach risk thresholds or exhibit dangerous patterns.

steps.title: Improve with AI insights
steps.description: Review AI-generated pre-market analysis, track your discipline score, and complete guided end-session reviews to build better habits.

technology.label: Technology

technology.intro: TradeSafe uses AI to analyze behavioral patterns — not to predict markets.

technology.vision: TradeSafe started with a simple idea: better trading starts with better discipline. The next generation expands that vision into deterministic market analysis, strategy logic, risk governance and, ultimately, safe execution automation.

legal.label: Legal & Compliance
legal.title: Disclaimer
paragraphs: TradeSafe is a behavioral discipline and decision-support tool.
It does not provide financial advice, trading signals, or portfolio management services.
TradeSafe connects to your trading platform via API solely to monitor your activity — it does not execute, modify, or suggest trades.
You remain fully responsible for all trading decisions, risk exposure, and compliance with local regulations.

footer.description: AI-powered behavioral intervention technology helping retail traders protect their capital and develop sustainable discipline.
